checks: History opens a separate read-only 3D scene with saved dates, summaries and inspectable notes
Earlier revisions retain deleted suborbitals and their independent saved notes
Browsing, heat, camera controls and revision stepping never save, alter backups or change the active camera
Export with history includes the current JSON, all saved JSON states and timestamped change metadata without creating a revision
Cancelling a restoration leaves the active atlas, browser and complete history unchanged
A failed restoration preserves the preview, current notes and recorded history
History navigation, restoration, export, 3D preview and notes fit the minimum browser window
Restore appends a new revision and retains every later saved state, including deleted concepts
Cancel before opening History preserves the complete unsaved main-note draft
Discard opens the saved state without recording a draft; Return to present leaves the active file untouched
Save before opening History records the note once and exposes it in the newest revision
